description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Announcements have ARP sender_hw = DUT interface MAC (RFC 3927 §2.4, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The Announcement's ARP sender_hw is what receivers cache as the new owner's MAC. RFC 3927 §2.4 requires it to equal the DUT's iface MAC — anything else corrupts the segment's ARP cache (LL would map to a wrong MAC).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → Announcement(s).

3. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Announcement
     - ARP sender_hw == DUT iface MAC   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Announcement ARP sender_hw equals the DUT's interface MAC.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_announce_sender_hw_not_dut_mac — Announcement sender_hw differs from the DUT's outgoing iface MAC
• Fail_no_announce_after_probes — DUT did not emit any Announcement after the Probe phase

verdicts.Pass: Announcement carries DUT iface MAC as sender_hw — normal
verdicts.Fail_announce_sender_hw_not_dut_mac: Announcement sender_hw is not the DUT's interface MAC
verdicts.Fail_no_announce_after_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Announcement after Probes
